claims.assertion: Yazhi says Taygeta began during the Great Expansion with settlers who already had interstellar technology.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She disputes an 850,000-year date as unmeasurable.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Taygetans navigate interstellar distances through frequency maps, using star charts as interpretive aids rather than precise navigation calculations.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says light-years remain a human-facing approximation.

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes an etheric heat pump that draws atmospheric charge through tubes to warm homes and cool them in summer.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She compares its principle to atmospheric charge collectors called pyramids.
